stats.notes: Only B1 and C1 are filled in the CDS PDF (first-year applicants 2,285 men + 2,554 women; admits 2,070 + 2,319). The enrolled count is left null because the form's C1 enrollee fields disagree with each other; the international and in-state/out-of-state split is blank; no test, GPA or C7 factor data. College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024): 5,037 applicants, 89% admitted, 13% of admits enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment 3,436 is CDS B1 total undergraduates, fall 2025; student-faculty ratio 13:1 from College Navigator (the CDS gives 12:1).
